content.text:
The **next NBA game** is **Knicks @ Spurs — Wednesday, June 3, 2026, 8:30 PM ET / 7:30 PM CT at Frost Bank Center in San Antonio**. ([nypost.com](https://nypost.com/2026/05/30/sports/spurs-stun-thunder-to-set-up-nba-finals-showdown-with-knicks/?utm_source=openai))

Best places to get tickets:

1. **Ticketmaster** — the NBA’s official ticketing partner; safest starting point for primary/verified resale tickets. ([help.ticketmaster.com](https://help.ticketmaster.com/hc/en-us/articles/27533401409041-NBA-National-Basketball-Association?utm_source=openai))  
2. **Frost Bank Center / Spurs official site** — good for official arena/game-day info and any team-controlled ticket releases.  
3. **Verified resale marketplaces** — SeatGeek, StubHub, TickPick, Gametime, etc. Compare final “all-in” prices and fees.

A heads-up: reported get-in prices for Game 1 in San Antonio are already very high — roughly **$1,000+** on resale marketplaces and about **$1,265+** via Ticketmaster in recent reporting. ([mysanantonio.com](https://www.mysanantonio.com/sports/spurs/article/knicks-vs-spurs-tickets-nba-finals-22284771.php?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me your city or which team you want to see, I can point you to the most relevant game and ticket options.
